planSteps.description: Navigate directly to /studio?template=hearth-ghost on the target website. This opens the built-in Hearth Ghost drawing; do not open a blank New drawing or the landing-page Ghost demonstration.
Verify Studio is open with a 16 by 16 drawing canvas and one timeline frame.
Open Tools in the inspector.
Create a motion part from the artwork.
Verify the rigid-part editor opens on End pose with position X equal to zero.
Enter 12 in Position X pixels and commit the numeric field.
Verify Position X pixels displays 12.
Choose Undo pose in the motion editor.
Verify Position X pixels returns to zero while the motion editor remains open.
Choose Redo pose in the motion editor.
Verify Position X pixels returns to 12.
Enter 30 in Motion frames and commit the numeric field.
Verify Motion frames and Generated Frames both display 30.
Choose Reset Pose.
Verify Position X pixels returns to zero.
Choose Undo pose.
Verify Position X pixels returns to 12 and Motion frames remains 30.
Enter 3 in Motion frames and commit the numeric field.
Choose BAKE TO TIMELINE in the motion editor and wait for the editor to close.
Verify the timeline has exactly three frames and the rigid-part editor has closed.
Choose the workspace Undo last action button.
Verify the timeline returns to exactly one frame.
Choose the workspace Redo last action button.
Verify the timeline returns to exactly three frames.
Choose the workspace Undo last action button again.
Verify the timeline returns to exactly one frame.
Open Tools and choose Create Motion Part again from the restored active layer.
Cancel the motion session.
Verify the motion editor closes, the timeline still has one frame, and the ghost artwork remains visible.
